configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Matches this project's default CMake option values exactly -- no FEMFX, no tetrahedralizer, no GPU profiler, no Lua. The smallest, fastest build; only kke_demo/imgui_demo/rmlui_demo and the test suite.

configurePresets.name: everything
configurePresets.description: Every optional piece this engine has, on at once: FEMFX physics, the CGAL tetrahedralizer tool, GPU profiling, and Lua scripting. This is what most people actively developing the engine itself want -- see INSTRUCTIONS.md for the system packages this needs first (CGAL/Boost for the tetrahedralizer in particular).
